app_info.subtitle: Continuity for AI agents
app_info.description: Organizational continuity for AI agents. Make AI work resumable, reviewable, and provable across agents. The task outlives the chat: OrgX lets the next agent continue from the decisions, artifacts, approvals, owners, and proof the last agent left behind. Users can search company context, inspect initiatives, review pending decisions, scaffold work, delegate agent tasks, and view interactive widgets for status and follow-up actions.

test_cases.description: Bootstrap the connected OrgX workspace and session guidance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start OrgX and show my workspace context.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected workspace context, granted scopes, and safe next-step guidance without exposing access tokens, raw session IDs, or secrets.

test_cases.description: List the deterministic seeded decisions awaiting approval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the pending decisions that need approval today.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the three seeded pending decisions with title, status, urgency or priority, and enough context to approve or reject.

test_cases.description: Search memory for a seeded initiative decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: What did we decide about Search Copilot readiness?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns prior decision and memory context for Search Copilot Readiness with relevant artifact or entity references.

test_cases.description: Render initiative health for a seeded initiative.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the pulse for the Search Copilot Readiness initiative.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the seeded initiative health, blockers if present, milestone/task summary, and the initiative-pulse widget.

test_cases.description: Render the current agent status widget.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me what the OrgX agents are doing right now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the seeded agent roster or active/idle agent state and the agent-status widget.

test_cases.description: Search organizational memory for the second seeded initiative.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search OrgX memory for workflow capture expansion.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns memory results that reference the Workflow Capture Expansion initiative.

test_cases.description: Create a bounded initiative hierarchy and show the widget result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Scaffold a launch initiative with two workstreams, one milestone each, and two tasks per milestone.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one initiative hierarchy matching the requested counts and renders the scaffolded-initiative widget.

test_cases.description: Delegate a budget-constrained agent task or return a structured blocker.
test_cases.user_prompt: Delegate research on launch risks to the operations agent with a cheapest valid validation budget under five dollars.
test_cases.expected_output: Either dispatches the operations task with the requested budget controls or returns a structured policy/auth blocker without spawning hidden work.
